# The High Pasture

*The ridge pasture can be used again, and Mabbu wants to see it with her own eyes, though she has not climbed that far since her knees gave out. Walk her up slowly to the high pasture on the Long Ridge.*

## Objectives

1. Talk to [Mabbu](../npcs/mabbu_tolmach.md)
2. Reach the high pasture in [The Long Ridge](../maps/long_ridge.md)
